empty.title: No workspace yet
empty.body: A workspace is an AI team working in one app folder: the orchestrator splits your task into subtasks for its teams, follows the flow you draw, and the audit layer checks every result. Start with a new folder, or let an agent read an app you already have.
empty.folderWithout: This folder has no workspace yet.
empty.pick: Pick a workspace on the left, or add one.

tree.label: Workspace canvas
tree.hint: Drag to move · Shift+drag selects an area, Shift+click adds or removes a node, then drag them together · drag the dot of an agent onto another agent (flow) or onto a skill · right-click for more · Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V copies a skill
tree.dragToConnect: Drag onto another agent to add a flow arrow
tree.connectHint: Click the agent that comes after {{name}}
tree.dragToSkill: Drag onto a skill to give this agent that skill

waiting.interrupted: The server restarted while this ran. Resume to continue where it left off.
waiting.provider_limit: The AI provider ran out of quota. Nothing was counted as failed: wait until it resets, then press Resume to continue from the same step.

permission.title: Agents will run without asking
permission.body: This workspace runs its sessions with bypassed permissions: agents edit files and run commands in its folder without asking you first.
permission.hint: You can switch to a stricter mode in the workspace settings. With stricter modes, approve tool calls by opening the session in chat.

settings.title: Workspace settings
settings.name: Workspace name
settings.maxParallel: Sessions running at the same time
settings.maxParallelHint: Subtask and audit sessions together, per task (1–6).

modeHints.bypassPermissions: Agents act without asking. Fastest, but review the result.
modeHints.acceptEdits: File edits are allowed; other tools wait for approval in chat.
modeHints.default: Every tool call waits for your approval in chat.

providers.title: Connect an AI provider
providers.subtitle: Agents run on the provider CLIs installed on the server this app runs on. Log in to at least one; only connected providers show up in the model list.
providers.hint: Connect opens a terminal on the server (your VPS, for example) and runs the provider's login command there. The login stays on that server; the workspace never stores an API key.
providers.noneBanner: No AI provider is connected yet, so agents cannot run
providers.disconnectedBanner: Agents use a provider that is not connected: {{providers}}

sidebar.label: Workspaces
sidebar.title: Workspace
sidebar.deleteWorkspaceBody: Delete "{{name}}" with all its tasks? The folder {{path}} and its files stay as they are.

addWorkspace.title: Add workspace
addWorkspace.intro: A workspace always works in one folder. Where should this one work?
addWorkspace.newBody: Start an app from scratch in a new, empty folder, with the default teams.
addWorkspace.existingBody: Point at its folder; an agent reads the code and proposes teams that fit it.
addWorkspace.newFolderHint: Type the full path of the new folder (it is created for you), or browse to a parent folder and add the name.
addWorkspace.existingFolderHint: The folder of the app. Nothing in it is changed while it is analysed.
addWorkspace.alreadyHasWorkspace: This folder already has a workspace.
addWorkspace.setupIntro: How should the workspace for {{name}} be staffed?
addWorkspace.analyseTitle: Let an agent analyse the app
addWorkspace.analyseBody: It reads the repository (read-only) and proposes teams and roles for this app. You review them before anything is created.
addWorkspace.noProvider: Connect a provider first to run the analysis.
addWorkspace.useDefaults: Skip the analysis and use the default teams
addWorkspace.reviewIntro: Proposed teams. Rename, edit, remove or add before creating; the orchestrator and the audit layer are added for you.
addWorkspace.summary: About the app (given to the orchestrator)
addWorkspace.backgroundHint: You can close this dialog: the analysis keeps running on the server and shows up in the workspace sidebar, where you can reopen it to review the result.
addWorkspace.waitingForAgent: Waiting for the agent to start…

flow.explain: Work of {{to}} waits until the work of {{from}} in the same task is done. Teams on separate branches run in parallel.

files.rightClickHint: Right-click a file or folder to download it.

usage.note: From each provider's own transcript. Cache tokens are usually much cheaper than input tokens.
